text.tspan: MASS MERGE EVENT
@unhappychoice detonates 213 commits on a Sunday. Analysts shaken.
FLEET WIDE ALERT
@unhappychoice updates deps across 20+ repos. No crate left behind.
TOOL IS BROKEN
@unhappychoice discovers lintric HTML report never worked. Ever. Not once.
EXIT CODE CRISIS
@unhappychoice finds lintric exits 0 on every error. Fixes it. CI saved.
HISTORIC MERGE
@unhappychoice ships gitlogue v0.11.0 with Godot syntax highlighting
41 REVIEWS
@unhappychoice blankets mdts in review comments. Changes requested. Twice.
GHOST BINARY
@unhappychoice finds release workflow archiving a path that never existed
SPLASHBOARD LIVE
@unhappychoice syncs LLM pricing from LiteLLM. The dashboard knows all.
